messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert: redwood-db-prod: high db_connection_utilization (>95%) detected. Pager: PD-INC-8421. link: https://pd.example/INC8421 :rotating_light:
pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident INC8421 fired and routed to oncall. Escalation level 1. Autoresolve: off.
Alicia (oncall): acked via PagerDuty — I'm on it. quick glance: metrics dashboard shows active_connections ~ 980 / 1000, pgbouncer_clients high. also seeing increased 5xx from inference-gateway.
Ben H: I can jump in 2 min. ping me if you want me to take ownership.
Alicia (oncall): assign to Ben, I need to coordinate with infra. Ben, top suspects: pg maxconn hit OR pgbouncer accept-queue. Also possible KV cache missstorm forcing too many DB hits.
Ben H: taking. first step: check pgbouncer stats + recent deploys. running: ```curl -s http://ops-metrics/pgbouncer | jq '.clients, .pool_count'```
Ben H: pgbouncer shows Cl_active=950, Cl_waiting=230, pools exhausted on app_pool_*; pgbouncer_accept_queue length growing.
Chris M: also seeing Redis miss rate spike on embedding-cache; TTLs thrashed. Could be upstream burst from batch-runner triggering many cache keys expiring simultaneously.
Alicia (oncall): ok escalate to oncall-sre for possible traffic-shaping. I'll open a short incident note and set status channel. :memo:
DevOps Runbook Bot: Runbook matched: DB-ACCEPTQUEUE-HANDOFF. Recommended actions: 1) enable readonly fallback for non-critical routes 2) increase pgbouncer_max_client_conn temporarily 3) throttle inference gateway connections 4) check for noisy job.
Ben H: doing safe change now: bump pgbouncer max_client_conn + add temporary accept_backoff. running (dry): ```kubectl -n infra exec pgbouncer-ops -- psql -c "ALTER SYSTEM SET max_client_conn = 1600; SELECT pg_reload_conf();"```
Ben H: applied on primary pgbouncer pod, rolling to secondaries. watch logs: ```kubectl -n infra logs -f pgbouncer-ops | tail -n 50```
Alicia (oncall): meanwhile, I'm putting inference-gateway into degraded mode -> will enable connection pooling at app-level and reduce concurrency to avoid hammering DB. patch: ```/services/inf-gw: set MAX_DB_CONNS=8```
PagerDuty: Ben H acknowledged incident INC8421. Escalation paused.
Ben H: seeing immediate drop in Cl_waiting from 230 -> 90 over ~60s. connection wait latency down from 420ms -> 110ms.
Chris M: Redis miss rate still high but origin traffic to DB decreased by ~45%. suspect cache warmup job still running (cron: embedding-refresh).
Alicia (oncall): Requesting product to temporarily pause background embedding refresh job. @product: can you pause job run-id 2026-03-15-emb-77?
Ben H: Product replied (in DM): pausing now.
Product Ops (via DM): paused job.
Ben H: after pausing, DB connections dropped to 240 active, 12 waiting. latency 80-130ms. looks stable.
Alicia (oncall): customer-impact: brief period (~9m) of elevated 5xx and timeouts for write-heavy inference requests, estimated ~0.8% of requests in that window. No data loss.
PagerDuty: Incident INC8421: auto-escalation timer cancelled (acknowledged).
Chris M: quick note: embedding cache keys showed TTL=0 for many keys due to mis-scheduled TTL refresh, causing stampede on reload. We'll add jitter to refresh window in follow-up.
Ben H: rolling back pgbouncer sysconf to original now that load cooled, but leaving minor backoff rule for 30m. command: ```ALTER SYSTEM SET max_client_conn = 1000; SELECT pg_reload_conf();```
Alicia (oncall): leaving a short mitigation checklist: - throttled inference-gateway -> reduced DB churn - paused noisy background job - temporarily bumped pgbouncer then rolled back - enabled app-level pooling - increased short-term monitoring windows for DB and cache
Ben H: metrics snapshot: peak active_connections 985, peak waiting 245, peak p50 latency 820ms -> post-fix p50 120ms.
Alicia (oncall): handing off to Chris for post-incident RCA and long-term fixes. Chris, please capture follow-up items: add jitter + circuit-breaker on embedding refreshes, improve pgbouncer alerts to include accept_queue length, add deploy-time guard for TTL changes.
Chris M: will do. I'll create a postmortem doc and link here. ETA 48h.
Alicia (oncall): thanks team. final status: mitigated, functional degraded mode briefly, customer impact minor. closing PD incident now. :white_check_mark:
PagerDuty: Incident INC8421 resolved by Alicia (oncall).
Ben H: filing short runbook updates and adding safe defaults to staging.
Chris M: posting RCA doc in #incidents when ready. also adding metric: redis_miss_streak to SLO alerts.
Alicia (oncall): handoff complete. next oncall: Ben H for monitoring window. end thread. :thumbsup:
